disclaimer.title: Before you start
disclaimer.body.1: Health Trail is a record-keeping app for family caregivers. It is not a medical app. It gives no medical advice. Nothing in it replaces a doctor, a nurse, emergency services, or legal advice from a lawyer. If someone needs urgent help, call emergency services.
disclaimer.body.2: What you record here is yours. It stays on this phone, and you are responsible for what you write down.
